items.description: CyberPowerPC GMA5600BSTV5 - Icy Waters game PC (Best Buy)
items.notes: Best Buy Scottsdale 7/31/26, $1,367.77 (July bank statement). Tom confirmed 2026-09-03 this Best Buy charge is the PC, not the projector. Spec photo of the box label to follow. Unbundling Icy Waters (local PC + local projector + Kleader sensor/SDK) was the plan that saved ~$1,700 against the $5,150 turnkey quote. || SPEC (box label): Ryzen 5 8400F up to 4.7GHz, 16GB DDR5, RTX 3050 6GB, 1TB Gen4 NVMe, Win11 HOME, WiFi6+BT, kbd+mouse, 1yr warranty. Adequate for Unity + TUIO on a single projector output - GPU is not the bottleneck for this game. *** OPERATIONAL RISK: Windows 11 HOME cannot defer feature updates the way Pro can and will force restarts. On an unattended installed game in Virginia that means a reboot mid-operating-day with nobody on site who knows what to do. SOLVED BY TOM 2026-09-03: AIR-GAP IT. No internet = no Windows Update = no forced reboots. PC talks only to the Pi over a local network with no WAN route. This is standard practice for installed exhibit/AV machines and is better than fighting Active Hours. PRE-SHIP CHECKLIST: (1) while still online, confirm Windows is ACTIVATED, install all drivers + Unity runtime + Kleader SDK, and run updates ONCE so it ships current; (2) then disconnect for good; (3) auto-login + game auto-launch so it self-recovers from a power cut; (4) no NTP offline means clock drift - only matters if the game timestamps anything; (5) TRADEOFF: offline means no remote support from Arizona. If remote fixes are wanted later, put the PI on the internet as the jump box and keep the PC air-gapped behind it. ***
